What to include in your message

If you know them, these details can help us understand the problem and suggest a useful next step:

  • Which device or service is affected
  • What happens, including any exact error message
  • When it started and whether anything changed around that time
  • Whether the issue affects one device or several

Please leave out passwords, one-time codes, and banking details.
